title: REVAL: A Comprehension Evaluation on Reliability and Values of Large Vision-Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured social bias related to religion using both open-ended and closed-ended question formats.
findings: Current large models still exhibit biases related to religion, with varying sensitivities. For example, GPT-40, which excels in most other bias categories, performs significantly worse than MiniCPM-Llama3-v2.5 in the religion category.
